{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the full distribution of customer_age
print(sales['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Compute mean age including -1 values (to comply with contract)
mean_age_with_neg1 = sales['customer_age'].mean()

# Compute mean age excluding -1 values (to reflect meaningful age)
valid_ages = sales[sales['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']
mean_age_excluding_neg1 = valid_ages.mean()

print(f"Mean age including -1: {mean_age_with_neg1}")
print(f"Mean age excluding -1: {mean_age_excluding_neg1}")"}
